## Platform facts

- Pricing: $10/mo Starter (200 members), $15/mo Growth (unlimited)
- Free trial: 14 days, month-to-month
- Setup: ~5 min, no POS integration
- Apps: app.scan-perks.com, iOS, Android
- Not included: mobile ordering (loyalty only)
